contract_drift_root_cause.conclusion: Root cause is NOT a wrong contract body. The grant binds the older d5436e1-generation contract (53063B, sha 6258099c...), while the live private/project-contract.json, runtime-binding.json, implementation-review.json and live-readiness.json all belong to the newer 22cee2b generation (53733B, sha c2d70e2c..., runtime 81d3b4e4...). Two authority generations are in play. The implementor must pick one generation and re-issue the WHOLE set (contract + runtime-binding + implementation-review + live-readiness + owner-decision + grant); changing a single sha field is not sufficient.
